reporting_scope: Official FY2024 PaymentAccuracy annual-workbook facts and reviewed program-specific supporting evidence, with each measurement period and evidence class preserved.

evidence_class_legend.meaning: A source-published estimate for a sampled payment universe; not a transaction ledger or automatically collectible amount.
A separately reported status that is added to, not relabeled as, classified improper payments.
A separate annual-workbook table limited to court-confirmed cases; not established as a disjoint subset of estimated improper payments.
Identified and recovered amounts reported on their own operational periods and bases; not automatically traceable to a statistical estimate.
A reviewed evidence-coverage decision used inside TAXLANE; not a public performance or savings finding.

ordered_program_cards.public_question: What same-cohort records connect the statistical estimate to final debt, appeal, collectibility, collection, and control cost?
How are state-cycle samples, payment components, exclusions, and weights combined into the national estimate?

ordered_program_cards.program_name: VA Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
open_fields: documentation defect versus recoverable overpayment basis
ordered_program_cards.public_question: Which privacy-safe same-cohort records connect sampled classifications to bills, disputes, collectibility, and certified cash?
What reproducible current-cycle estimator, exclusion, uncertainty, appeal, debt, and collection records support the reported result?

bounded_examples.title: FY2024 covered-program composition
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: The official FY2024 workbook's 68 program rows cover $4,071,860.585 million in outlays and report $148,970.633 million classified improper plus $12,569.500 million unknown, for $161,540.133 million improper plus unknown.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: Coverage is not the full federal payment universe and program measurement periods vary.

bounded_examples.title: Corrected VA PLTSS projected result
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: The official FY2024 PLTSS result is a projected $218.30 million overpayment estimate at 3.88 percent for payments sampled from October 2022 through September 2023.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: The estimate is not established debt or collection, and the later FY2025 AFR measurement cycle must not be blended into it.

bounded_examples.title: Federal Crop Insurance FY2024 composition
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: For the July 2021 through June 2022 sample period, the annual row reports $23,867.31 million in outlays and $579.36 million improper, comprising $573.93 million overpayments and $5.43 million underpayments.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: This is a sampled-universe estimate; the unaudited $579.93 million apparent typo is excluded and the annual-row margin-of-error unit is undisclosed.

bounded_examples.title: Medicare Part D FY2024 composition
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: For the CY2022 sample period, the annual row reports $96,521.39 million in outlays and $3,575.09 million improper, comprising $3,052.65 million overpayments and $522.44 million underpayments, with technical and unknown categories reported as zero.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: The composition is a statistical estimate, not identified or collectible debt.

bounded_examples.title: Medicare Part D documentation dependency
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: CMS's corrected 3.16 percent Part D overpayment result separates a 2.70 percent documentation component from 0.46 percent drug and pricing discrepancies.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: A documentation-related measurement failure is not a transaction-level debt ledger. The sponsor-documentation dependency field is closed internally; the other five methodology fields remain open.

bounded_examples.title: Medicare Part D published uncertainty
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: CMS publishes a 95 percent confidence interval of $3.19 billion to $4.01 billion and 3.31 percent to 4.15 percent around the rounded $3.58 billion and 3.70 percent gross improper-payment result.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: The annual-row 0.42 margin-of-error value has no disclosed unit or formula, must not be forced to reconstruct the intervals, and the gross interval must not be applied to a net result.

bounded_examples.title: VA PLTSS recovery rows remain separate
bounded_examples.allowed_wording: The scorecard separately reports recovery activity of $6.91 million identified and $4.46 million recovered, recovery audit activity of $1.18 million and $0.76 million, and FY2023-FY2025 PIIA sample and deep-dive activity of $3.97 million and $3.71 million, each with its own period and basis.
bounded_examples.required_caveat: Same period, same definition, estimate-to-debt lineage, debt-to-collection lineage, and row disjointness are all unestablished.
prohibited_inferences: divide recovery by the $218.30 million estimate

comparison_rules: Match program, tested-payment cohort, evidence class, units, and definitions before comparing amounts.
Keep classified improper payments separate from unknown-payment status.
Keep statistical estimates separate from court-confirmed fraud and operational recovery rows.
Do not sum, subtract, divide, net, or rank mixed-period or unmatched-basis records.
Internal methodology closure counts describe evidence coverage, not program performance.
use: transparent correction of prior extraction error
